integrity: The finite verifier is supplied in full and checks bounded orders; no external or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only integer partitions into exactly three positive parts and ordinary one-part intersection; the infinite proof is in RESULT.md, not inferred from enumeration. The known exceptional order eight predates this result. No classification of all sharp four-member nontrivial families is claimed. Priority beyond the cited literature has not been independently audited.
title: A sharp four-family barrier for intersecting three-part integer partitions
